# Load and Wrangle

```{r}
path <- "sim/thesis_sim/"
# file <- "S4_2_1_T50_M500.rds"
file <- "S100_10_3_1_sparse46_T50_M500.rds"

result_list <- readRDS(paste0(path, file))
h <- 4
M <- 500

# flatten out the sublist in `e`
flatten_e_list <- function(e_list) {
  out <- list()

  for (name in names(e_list)) {
    obj <- e_list[[name]]

    if (is.list(obj) && all(vapply(obj, is.matrix, logical(1)))) {
      ## e.g. name == "mint_shr_pc", obj contains K1 … K20
      for (k in names(obj)) {
        out[[k]] <- obj[[k]]   # “mint_shr_pc_K1”, …
      }
    } else {
      out[[name]] <- obj                               # “base”, “ols”, …
    }
  }
  out                                             # all matrices at top level
}

all_model_names <- names(flatten_e_list(result_list[[1]]$e))
series_names <- rownames(S)
SSE_cum <- setNames(
  lapply(all_model_names, function(name) {
    matrix(0, h, length(series_names), dimnames = list(1:h, series_names))
  }),
  all_model_names
)
# need to square the errors first
SSE_cum <- Reduce(
  function(acc, res) {
    e_flat <- flatten_e_list(res$e)
    Map(function(x, y) x + y^2, acc, e_flat[ names(acc) ])   # element-wise matrix addition
  },
  result_list,
  init = SSE_cum
)


MSE <- lapply(SSE_cum, function(mat) mat / M)
```


# Plotting
```{r}
MSE_ts <- transform_sim_MSE(MSE, F)

# % improv plot
# average first, then compute % change later
MSE_ts |>
  # filter(.model %in% c("base", "ols", "mint_shr", "mint_n")) |>
  filter(!grepl("hcov|sv", .model)) |>
  # filter(.model != "hresid_mint_n_hcov") |>
  group_by(series, h) |>
  mutate(
    base_MSE = MSE[.model == "base"]
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(.model, h) |>
  summarise(
    MSE = mean(MSE),
    base_MSE = mean(base_MSE),
    pct_change = (MSE - base_MSE) / base_MSE * 100
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = h, y = pct_change, color = .model)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# score_list <- readRDS("sim/thesis_sim/scores_S100_10_3_1_sparse46_T50_M500.rds")

score_df <- result_winklers_80 |> 
  transform_sim_MSE(F) |> 
  # change column name "h" to "iter", "MSE" to "score"
  rename(iter = h, score = MSE)

# wrangle
{
  # filter pc2 models
  score_df <- score_df %>%
    filter(!grepl("K2", .model)) |> # remove pc2 models
    filter(.model != "base_shr") |> 
    filter(.model != "mint_sample")
  # % improvements per series
  score_df <- score_df |>
    group_by(series, iter) |>
    mutate(
      base_score = score[.model == "base"]
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(pct_change_per_series = (score - base_score) / base_score * 100)
}
```

```{r}
score_label <- "W95"
score_df |> 
  group_by(.model) |> 
  summarise(
    pct_change_avg = mean(pct_change_per_series)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = .model, y = pct_change_avg, fill = .model)) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(x = "Model", y = "% improvements",
         title = paste("Average of % relative improvements in", score_label, "compared to Base"),
         subtitle = "Interpret: negative values indicate improvement. Avg over pct") +
    theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
{
  energy_df <- result_energy[,1:11] |> 
    as_tibble(rownames = "iter") |>

    mutate(iter = as.integer(iter))
  # pct change
  energy_df <- energy_df |> 
    group_by(iter) |>
    mutate(
      base_score = score[.model == "base"],
      pct_change_per_series = (score - base_score) / base_score * 100
    )
}
# overall energy score per model
energy_df |> 
  group_by(.model) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_score = mean(score),
    pct_change_avg = mean(pct_change_per_series)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = .model, y = pct_change_avg, fill = .model)) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(x = "Model", y = "% improvements",
         title = "Average of % relative improvements in Energy Score compared to Base",
```
